# DRank

> Ahrefs Domain Rating tracker feeding High Signal /domains and fleet domain marketing work.

## Product

- [Home](https://domains.sassmaker.com/): Track Domain Rating history locally without an account
- [Public DR dataset](https://domains.sassmaker.com/data): Inspect and download weekly public Domain Rating observations
- [Changelog](https://domains.sassmaker.com/changelog): Verified DRank product and release history

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://domains.sassmaker.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [Homepage markdown](https://domains.sassmaker.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
- [This index](https://domains.sassmaker.com/llms.txt)
